column4: The MySQL-only probe-scoping test (cleat#3455) opens the MySQL arm of compactDialects, so it skips whenever CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL is not set. One skip, by name; it RUNS in multi-db/mysql and multi-db/postgres, which set the DSN. Measured by name on the PR's own CI run: multi-db/mssql and cluster each reported one unattributed skip, this test.
